# account status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:accountStatus`](gmeow-accountStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/accountStatus>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accounts`](../../slices/accounts.md)

The holder's usage status of an account — a [`gmeow:AccountStatus`](../classes/gmeow-AccountStatus.md) value (active / dormant / historical). A retired account is status 'historical' with [`validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) in the past, never deleted (P10).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineAccount.md) -> [`gmeow:AccountStatus`](../classes/gmeow-AccountStatus.md)

## Usage Advice

### Scope notes

- Source-variable observation, deliberately NOT functional: competing source- or standpoint-asserted statuses coexist (P9). A functional object property would force the distinct [`AccountStatus`](../classes/gmeow-AccountStatus.md) values to be [owl:sameAs](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs) and could drive a global OWL inconsistency that halts reasoning.
